capabilities: Browse a monthly heatmap of file edit activity
Filter edited files by selecting a date
Show edited files in a collapsible folder tree with compressed single-child folders
Open any listed file in Obsidian
Configure the darkest heat threshold (1-100 files)
extras: README includes an unusual section publishing daily snapshots of the plugin's cumulative download counts; activity history is local-only with no network requests.
problem: Obsidian makes it easy to find notes by name or search terms, but hard to answer what you were working on on a given day when you have forgotten the filename.
summary: Activity heatmap calendar that lists the Markdown files edited on a selected date in a collapsible folder tree.
